headline: US Home Sellers Lower Prices and Concede Ground Amid Market Stagnation
summary: US home sellers are cutting prices and assisting buyers to close deals in a stagnant market. Surging mortgage rates, elevated home prices, and inflation have left many properties sitting without buyers.
why: Housing market activity is a major driver of US consumer net worth, construction spending, and mortgage finance demand.

impacts.name: US Residential Real Estate
impacts.why: Elevated borrowing rates and affordability barriers are dampening transaction volumes and forcing pricing concessions.
